title: Tamsin and the Bridge
author: Zephyrine Galloway
blurb: Rafael Oyelaran, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
